entries.heading: PROHIBITION ON CONSTRUCTION OF PROVISIONS OF THIS TITLE AS AN AUTHORIZATION FOR USE OF MILITARY FORCE
ancestors: TITLE LXXIV—CAESAR SYRIA CIVILIAN PROTECTION ACT OF 2019
entries.text:
SEC. 7437. PROHIBITION ON CONSTRUCTION OF PROVISIONS OF THIS TITLE 
                          AS AN AUTHORIZATION FOR USE OF MILITARY 
                          FORCE.

    Nothing in this title may be construed as an authorization for use 
of military force.
